bullets.text: Halvern Dam on the Sorrel River above Brindlemark in the Assek Valley was damaged, together with its right abutment, on 9 September 2025, triggering a dam safety emergency.
The alert level was raised from Yellow to Orange the following morning and a mandatory evacuation was ordered for Brindlemark and Ferris Hollow, with people later also evacuated from Quennard.
Roughly 11,800 residents were evacuated from Brindlemark in the first phase, a figure that rose to 12,400 by the end of the reporting window.
Brindlemark Police deployed to the town and assistance was provided in Quennard, while the Sorrel Basin Water Authority issued information on the dam.
